verdict.conclusion: CPU evaluation is bit-reproducible across the full materialize -> reload -> measure cycle, so 1e-4 is above the noise this path produces.
verdict.NOT_established: GPU repeatability. The pilot's evaluation backend is a GPU, where reduction order is not guaranteed across launches and bf16/fp32 accumulation can move a KL in the last digits. This CPU result bounds the deterministic path only. The micro-preflight measures the same quantity on an L40S with the real teacher and the real suite, and epsilon is confirmed or reset from that number BEFORE any candidate is ranked.

pooled_denominators.note: pooled counts, per the frozen SeedAggregation

equivalence_interval.SINGLE_DEFINITION: interval = 2 * sqrt(p_control * (1 - p_control) / n_pooled). The formula is frozen now; the numeric value is materialized from the control characterization and never changes afterwards. There is no second, prior-derived constant.
equivalence_interval.free_input: control correct_overall on the recovery-search battery

illustrative_only_at_historical_prior.source: retained reference on the 150-prompt promotion battery
illustrative_only_at_historical_prior.WARNING: illustrative sizing only. This value is NOT the threshold and must not be used for selection; the materialized value comes from the control's own measurement on recovery_search_v1.

equivalence_interval.why_two_se: one SE would call a difference decisive that a rerun could reverse; two SE is the smallest interval this denominator can support

feasibility_floor.rule: max(absolute_floor, control_usable_pooled - 3 x SE), where SE is the binomial standard error of usable_rollout_rate on the pooled all-prompt denominator
feasibility_floor.absolute_floor_rationale: guards the 'cannot hold a rollout at all' case independently of how the control happens to score; a candidate below it cannot produce trajectories for Stage 5 regardless of correctness
feasibility_floor.relative_term_rationale: guards against a candidate that is severely less stable than the incumbent without requiring parity, which would make feasibility a second ranking
feasibility_floor.free_input: control usable_rollout_rate on the recovery-search battery

catastrophic_per_capability_floor.rule: a candidate is excluded if any scorable set's usable rate is below 0.10 while the control's is above 0.40 on that set
catastrophic_per_capability_floor.rationale: a candidate that collapses on one capability while averaging acceptably is not a usable initialization, and the pooled rate can hide it
catastrophic_per_capability_floor.status: rule frozen, thresholds analytic, control values pending

seed_noise_context.implication: far larger than the equivalence interval above, which is why two seeds are pooled rather than compared, and why a third seed exists for ties

recovery_thresholds.STATUS: RULES FROZEN, NUMBERS PENDING. The two free inputs are measured on the canonical control in the micro-preflight, before any searched candidate is probed.
